probes.name: the kill switch no longer forces standard
probes.comment: non-first-party providers under CLAUDIN_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS must get 'standard' when ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH is unset

probes.name: genuine first-party loses its kill-switch exception
probes.comment: Anthropic on api.anthropic.com (or no profile) keeps tool search under the kill switch

probes.name: auto:0 stops meaning always-on
probes.comment: auto:0 (and a negative auto:N clamped to 0) is 'tst', not 'tst-auto'

probes.name: Haiku 4.x is treated as supporting tool_reference
probes.comment: the claude-haiku-4 pattern is what keeps Haiku 4.5 out of tool search

probes.name: the optimistic proxy gate stops firing
probes.comment: firstParty transport on a non-Anthropic base URL with ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH unset must be optimistic-false

probes.name: tool_reference blocks are no longer read from tool_result content
probes.comment: extractDiscoveredToolNames must collect tool_name from tool_reference items

probes.name: the compact boundary's discovered set is dropped
probes.comment: compactMetadata.preCompactDiscoveredTools must be carried into the set
probes.replace: for (const name of carried) void name

probes.name: the tst-auto char threshold inverts
probes.comment: deferred descriptions at/above the char threshold enable tool search; below it they do not
